headline: Flat ₹250 cashback on bus tickets (min ₹2000)
description: Flat 250 rupees cashback on bus ticket bookings of 2000 rupees or more on Paytm. Cashback is credited within 24 hours.
how_to_redeem:
1. Book a bus ticket on the Paytm app or paytm.com (min 2000 rupees, excluding insurance and free cancellation).
2. Apply promocode OCTFEST.
3. Complete the payment.
terms: All users; once per user; min order 2000 rupees excluding insurance and free cancellation; verified mobile number needed; cancelled orders not eligible.
